data.title: 提丰 · 煎好的蘑菇先给你尝
data.description: 家里小厨房，提丰穿梅紫棉裙与燕麦色围裙，把煎好的蘑菇装进小碟递给你。她微微侧头等你评价，另一只手把锅铲搁在台面上；平底锅和切好的蔬菜都留在灶边。
data.action: 把装着煎蘑菇的小碟递向镜头，等待评价
data.promptProse: Typhon offers the small plate of sauteed mushrooms toward the viewer and tilts her head, waiting for their verdict. The spatula rests beside the pan under the warm kitchen pendant light.
data.animaCaption: She offers the mushroom plate toward the viewer, the spatula resting beside the pan as she waits for a verdict.
